name: Love at First Spike
source:
Welcome to  Love at First Spike!

Join the journey of being a volleyball manager, with your favorite Haikyuu boys! Pick which school you will attend and join the volleyball team as the team's manager. But tensions have gone up since you joined the team with your childhood friend. Can you rekindle this friendship or pursue your love interest?

[From [url=https://nahla.itch.io/haikyuu-otome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《爱在第一尖峰》！

与你最喜欢的排球男孩一起加入成为排球经理的旅程！选择你要就读的学校并作为球队经理加入排球队。但自从你和你儿时的朋友一起加入这个团队以来，紧张气氛就加剧了。你能重燃这段友谊或追求你的爱情吗？

[来自[url=https://nahla.itch.io/haikyuu-otome]Itch.io[/url]]
